art_direction: Minimal lateral 2D dark-fantasy pixel-art-inspired storyboard; large legible pixel clusters, cool blue-violet catastrophe palette, sparse amber fire, cinematic gutters, no copied external designs.

assets.prompt: A wordless nine-panel opening-comic reference: elf-only Golden City crowded with elves; council sends major families to seek homes; more than one hundred Thalestriel elves leave in a large open-wagon caravan with relics; monsters, enemies and natural disasters strike; plague kills nearly all; Lolth and eight survivors reach a root-lined cave with a broken wagon. Every Lolth panel visibly shows her furious at Eol with non-readable anger-cursing visual cues.
